patches.reason: Replace t3 application MCP/self-invocation/environment injection with ProviderRuntimeHost stdio/ACP-MCP bindings. Recheck exact execution ownership and original PM tool authorization. Keep original native lifecycle, cancellation, process scopes, models, configuration and requests. Unbound upstream runtime fixtures retain native behavior; bound PM resumes never silently replace a failed native target. Protocol/authority failures propagate directly; only actual native activation failures enter the original native activation-failure Ref.

Retain the actual initialize-response wire generation using effect-acp readAcpProtocolGeneration; do not infer dialect from protocolVersion. An initialized real runtime without this evidence fails rather than fabricating a dialect. Native adoption retains the current connection generation.

Expose operation-scoped readAcpSessionEvidence. Legacy metadata is captured from original native session/list or the original family metadata hook BEFORE load/resume. No ensure/new or probe prompt. Reject directory/cursor mismatch, running work, unfinished user history, background work and pending native requests. Existing valid sidecars bypass legacy metadata probing.

Buffered continuation adoption uses the original provider-owned message branch, original offered-request generation identity, original startTurn transition permit and current PM authority. Every native offer attaches hostExecution captured from the original openSession binding, never a newer callback-time binding. It never builds/sends a prompt or reopens quarantined/stopped generations. Do not wrap adoption in the original dispatchIfCurrent permit because that would deadlock the original startTurn permit.

Use actual MCP SDK StdioClientTransport, exact generation-bound named servers and explicit native environment/cwd. Preserve original typed ACP connect/message/notification/disconnect APIs, correlated native responses, cancellation, bounded admission/message size and process cleanup. Notifications without a real request ID do not enter request correlation; no synthetic IDs are assigned. No t3 HTTP business MCP token/endpoint. Disposal attempts every owned transport and surfaces cleanup failures.

Remove SelfInvocation/McpProviderSessions application dependencies and require the same ProviderRuntimeHost as the PM operation. Original family settings, auth, model, CLI preparation, version/status, maintenance and usage modules remain authoritative.

Export the existing original agent schema decoder and existing resolveAcpRegistryPlatformTarget/resolveAcpRegistryPlatformTargetCandidates helpers for one-time app-owned preparation metadata conversion. Main approved additive helper exports after semantic references in local://m4-acp-platform-export-refs.md; implementations and existing source callers are unchanged. No parallel catalog schema or duplicate platform selection logic.

Preserved preceding PM-FX-FORCED-MODE patch and its real typed-v2 regression: force setConfigOption with the ACP-v2 id discriminator even when advertised ask differs from enforced native mode. This slice does not overwrite that patch.

Retain executable original native suites while removing t3 business-only host/self-invocation dependencies. Reuse the shared real PM runtime-host fixture, not app ProviderReplayHarness or fake business projections. Add original-process v1-shape/advertised-version-2 dialect assertions and buffer-only adoption/current-generation assertions. Native source recording/replay helpers and scripts remain retained.

The provider-acp runtime requires the already pinned @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependency. Parent owns package/lock/build integration, original effect-acp readAcpProtocolGeneration and generic execution contracts.

Fresh generic ensureThread must use forceNewNativeThread:false: original ACP openSession already starts one native process/session. true deliberately replaces it and explains the prior two-process-per-operation symptom. Do not add a family shortcut or bypass original open.

Run readPreparedAcpRegistryConfigMigration once before workers and persist changed app-owned config with the existing startup/CAS policy without a spurious revision bump. Preserve instance IDs and exact validated existing commandPath. No per-request fallback, native execution/download, credential migration or new persistence design.

Host background-compaction and retained-instance continuation authorization resolve the current RuntimeHost generation, not the first acquisition context.execution. ACP composition passes the same runtimeHost to both landed shared services; delayed native offers carry only their originally captured hostExecution.

Original source buffered-carryover process asserts current-generation-only adoption, no duplicate drain, no native prompt and no reopened terminal child/lineage.

Actual SDK stdio MCP process covers native initialize/tools/list/tools/call, foreign-server rejection, revoked authority, interrupted outstanding request and bounded messages. Controlled tool is not PM17 business inference evidence.

Registry one-time preparation receipt conversion covers exact prior binary fingerprint/root/path and tampering rejection without changing context revision; source catalog/install suites retain original distribution behavior.
